text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 for customer 'Omega Health' (dedicated VPC) — possible cross-tenant response leakage detected in dedicated pool dc-us-east-3. Trigger: anomaly detection matched two responses containing 'patient_id' tokens not owned by requester. Pager: @sara-oncall ~2087654321

sara-oncall: Ack. I'm on it. Paging eng-runtime and eng-security. Can someone confirm scope? Any active deploys to dc-us-east-3?

raj-eng-runtime: On call. Looking at routing logs now. Pulling last 10min from redis/kvcache and envoy.

raj-eng-runtime: quick log extract:```
[2026-02-20T21:45:03Z] req_id=7f3a pool=dc-us-east-3 model=redwood-13B tenant=omega req_tenant=omega -> response contains redacted:{
  "user": "<REDACTED>",
  "patient_id": "P-82734",
  "note": "..."
}
[2026-02-20T21:45:05Z] req_id=7f3b pool=dc-us-east-3 model=redwood-13B tenant=omega req_tenant=other-tenant -> response contains redacted:{
  "user": "<REDACTED>",
  "patient_id": "P-82734",
}
```

maria-eng-security: wow. That looks like the same KV prefix was read for two different tenant requests. Possible cache key collision or stale routing table. Save those logs and don't rotate. We need chain-of-custody.

se-omega: Customer reports two end-users saw identical PHI-like tokens when querying different internal apps. They have paused traffic but want ETA. This is urgent — they're in healthcare.

ops-lead: @raj-eng-runtime can you isolate the pool? If it's a dedicated pool for Omega we should drain and reprovision. If shared, immediate isolation.

raj-eng-runtime: Taking dc-us-east-3 pool out of LB now. Command:```bash
./infractl pool disable --region us-east-3 --pool dc-us-east-3 --reason "isolation - suspected cross-tenant exposure"
# follow-up: ./infractl pool drain --grace 30s
```

deploy-bot: Automated action recorded: pool dc-us-east-3 set to DRAINING by raj-eng-runtime at 2087654387.

pm-prod: Noting customer comms thread. Recommend "we took action to isolate and are investigating for scope; will follow with remediation and timeline in 30 minutes".

maria-eng-security: While drain proceeds, collect full KV cache dump and envoy routing table for that pool. Preserve disk and memory images if possible. Evidence needs to be immutable.

raj-eng-runtime: Running snapshot commands now:
```bash
ssh gpu-node-12 "sudo dd if=/dev/shm/kvcache bs=1M | gzip > /tmp/kvcache-dc-us-east-3-2087654389.gz"
kubectl exec -n inference envoy-5 -- curl localhost:9901/config_dump > /tmp/envoy-config-dump.json
```

raj-eng-runtime: KV dump in /tmp uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-evidence/omega/2087654321/kvcache.gz (preserved). Envoy config attached to the same folder.

maria-eng-security: Good. Starting quick audit of cache key namespace. My suspicion: late-bind namespace prefix used for dedicated pools was not namespaced with tenant_id for 2 model variants. Searching code owner: @raj-eng-runtime and @ops-lead.

se-omega: Customer asking if any other tenants impacted. Do we have indicators?

raj-eng-runtime: Initial scan of recent request IDs shows only two suspicious cross-tenant hits matching the same patient token. I'm running a broader grep across last 6 hours across all pools to confirm.

raj-eng-runtime: scan status: 35% complete. If this is limited to dc-us-east-3 and only between Omega and a single other tenant, impact may be narrowly scoped.

maria-eng-security: Notify legal and compliance. Escalate to SOC for review — tag: "possible PHI exposure". Also create an evidence ticket.

ops-lead: Ops will coordinate hotfix to ensure cache keys include tenant_id. Patch candidate: add tenant prefix in kvcache keys and force cache purges. Need a short maintenance window if we roll hotfix.

pm-prod: Customer-facing message draft (for SE): "We've isolated the affected capacity, preserved logs, and are performing a targeted investigation. At this time we're unaware of broader impact. We'll update in 60 minutes with findings and remediation plan." Thoughts?

se-omega: Good. Send ASAP. They want confirmation of exposed records count if any.

raj-eng-runtime: Scan completed. Summary: only 2 request traces show duplicate PHI tokens across tenants within dc-us-east-3 between omega and tenant 'sunrise-clinic'. No other pools show matching tokens. Full grep output uploaded to evidence S3.

maria-eng-security: Confirming chain-of-custody and marking incident as P1 security. Creating JIRA INC-2087654321.

ops-lead: Hotfix plan: 1) deploy config change to add tenant prefix in cache key (canary one node), 2) purge existing kvcache entries for dc-us-east-3, 3) reprovision pool nodes. Rolling canary to prod after verification. Estimated 45-60 minutes.

raj-eng-runtime: Starting canary patch to one node now. Patch command:```bash
./deployctl canary --service kvcache --image redwood/kvcache:tenant-prefix-20260220 --nodes gpu-node-12
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started by raj-eng-runtime at 2087654550.

sara-oncall: Update: canary shows no new collisions for 10 minutes. Purge underway:```bash
./infractl kvcache purge --pool dc-us-east-3 --pattern "*" --confirm
```

se-omega: They've asked if we can provide a list of affected request IDs for their internal investigation. We should sanitize before sharing.

maria-eng-security: We'll provide redacted request IDs and timestamps. Legal approves redaction. No PHI to be shared externally.

ops-lead: After purge, we'll reprovision nodes and bring pool back to active with strict routing checks. Plan to bring back partial capacity for Omega only (hard-pinned).

raj-eng-runtime: Pool reprovisioned and traffic gated. Brought back Omega-only capacity at 2087654820. Monitoring for anomalies.

pm-prod: Sent update to customer: isolation, investigation underway, limited impact, ETA for remediation ~ 1 hour. Slack thread to SE updated with evidence link.

maria-eng-security: Final quick checks: no new cross-tenant hits post-purge. Marking containment achieved. Creating incident bridge for postmortem ops.

ops-lead: Follow-ups: root cause analysis (kvcache key namespace), code fix PR, deploy across all regions, audit other dedicated pools for similar late-bind code paths, customer notification package, and long-term SLA credit assessment.

sara-oncall: Handing off to morning oncall for full postmortem and customer comms. Notes: P1 -> contained, evidence preserved, Omega notified, short remediation rolling out. Assigning owner: @maria-eng-security for SOC postmortem and @ops-lead for deployment rollout.

maria-eng-security: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate legal & SOC and own the write-up.

se-omega: Thanks team. Customer relieved to hear containment. Please share final postmortem and remediation timeline when ready.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived as P1-security-2087654321. Postmortem template: https://redwood.company/incidents/templates/security-p1

sara-oncall: closing live pager. If anything pops, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
